title: Esho Maa Lakshmi
desc: Devotees celebrate Goddess Lakshmi with prayers, rituals and heartfelt devotion, seeking prosperity, blessings and harmony in their homes and lives.

title: Asha-O-Bhalobasa
desc: Bijoy is jailed after being framed by Bilas Dutta, a famous businessman, and unable to deal with it, his sister commits suicide. When he is released from prison, Bijoy vows to seek revenge.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.

title: Boumar Banabash
desc: A royal couple faces divine punishment as the wife endures exile while the prince grapples with a mysterious curse that threatens both love and destiny.

title: Rajar Meye Parul
desc: A childless king marries a woodcutter's daughter to gain an heir. However, his wives kill his seven children, leaving only his daughter Parul, who grows up to be a charming young lady.

title: Rahul D Best
desc: Talented singers stage performances and pay tribute to renowned singer, Rahul Dev Burman, by singing some of his most famous songs.
